data.label: BRFSS Respondent Governed Record
data.description: A BRFSS respondent record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier. Members: BRFSS Respondent; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov).

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: BRFSS Respondent
items.description: One BRFSS 2022 respondent: the sequence number, survey design, demographics, health status and access, chronic conditions, body measures, tobacco and alcohol, and disability, from the columns of the LLCP2022 file this demonstration carries. Members: Annual Sequence Number (SEQNO); BRFSS Survey Design; BRFSS Demographics; BRFSS Health Status and Access; BRFSS Chronic Conditions; BRFSS Body Measures; BRFSS Tobacco and Alcohol Use; BRFSS Disability.

items.label: Annual Sequence Number (SEQNO)
items.description: The BRFSS annual sequence number identifying the respondent within the year (SEQNO).

items.label: BRFSS Body Measures
items.description: Self-reported height and weight as the agency codes them, and as the FHIR vital signs panel by identifier (body height, body weight, BMI), with the agency's computed BMI category. Members: Reported Height in Feet and Inches (HEIGHT3); Reported Weight in Pounds (WEIGHT2); vital-signs-panel (FHIR); Computed Body Mass Index Category (_BMI5CAT).

items.label: Reported Height in Feet and Inches (HEIGHT3)
items.description: Self-reported height as coded (HEIGHT3: feet and inches as FII, or 9xxx for metres and centimetres). The FHIR body height beside it carries the value in centimetres.

items.label: Computed Body Mass Index Category (_BMI5CAT)
items.description: The agency's computed BMI category (_BMI5CAT).

items.label: Reported Weight in Pounds (WEIGHT2)
items.description: Self-reported weight without shoes, in pounds as reported (WEIGHT2; the agency's kilogram reports are converted). The FHIR body weight beside it carries the same value in kilograms.

items.label: Vital Signs Panel
items.description: The vital signs of one measurement session: height, weight, temperature, heart and respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, BMI and blood pressure.

items.label: Observation Status
items.description: The status of the observation result. FHIR Observation.status; ObservationStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Body Height
items.description: Body Height (LOINC 8302-2), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Mass Index
items.description: Body mass index (LOINC 39156-5) in kg/m2. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Temperature
items.description: Body Temperature (LOINC 8310-5), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Weight
items.description: Body Weight (LOINC 29463-7), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Heart Rate
items.description: Heart Rate (LOINC 8867-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Oxygen Saturation
items.description: Oxygen Saturation (LOINC 2708-6), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Respiratory Rate
items.description: Respiratory Rate (LOINC 9279-1), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Observation Date Time
items.description: The clinically relevant time of the observation. FHIR Observation.effectiveDateTime.

items.label: Blood Pressure
items.description: A blood pressure reading: systolic and diastolic, body site, status and time.

items.label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Diastolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8462-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Systolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8480-6), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Site (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The body site the observation was made on. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Observation.bodySite.

items.label: Code System: SNOMED CT
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: SNOMED CT (http://snomed.info/sct). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Body Site Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the body site the observation was made on. FHIR Observation.bodySite, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code (FHIR Coding.display).

items.label: BRFSS Chronic Conditions
items.description: The chronic health conditions section: the shared chronic condition indicators on a self-report basis, and whether asthma persists. Members: Chronic Condition Indicators; Still Have Asthma (ASTHNOW).

items.label: Still Have Asthma (ASTHNOW)
items.description: Whether the respondent still has asthma (ASTHNOW).

items.label: Chronic Condition Indicators
items.description: The chronic conditions a study records for a person, one indicator per condition, with the basis on which the study established them. NHANES and BRFSS carry the ones their questionnaires ask; CMS carries the eleven its chronic conditions flags define; every study that carries an indicator carries the same component. Members: Condition Indicator Basis; Condition: Asthma; Condition: Arthritis; Condition: Congestive Heart Failure; Condition: Coronary Heart Disease; Condition: Angina; Condition: Heart Attack; Condition: Stroke; Condition: Emphysema; Condition: Chronic Bronchitis; Condition: COPD; Condition: Liver Condition; Condition: Thyroid Problem; Condition: Cancer; Condition: Skin Cancer; Condition: Depression; Condition: Kidney Disease; Condition: Diabetes; Condition: Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder; Condition: Osteoporosis; Condition: High Blood Pressure; Condition: High Cholesterol.

items.label: Condition: Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder
items.description: Whether the person has alzheimer's disease or related disorder (Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder, SNOMED CT 26929004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by CMS SP_ALZHDMTA.

items.label: Condition: Angina
items.description: Whether the person has angina (Angina, SNOMED CT 194828000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160D.

items.label: Condition: Arthritis
items.description: Whether the person has arthritis (Arthritis, SNOMED CT 3723001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160A, BRFSS HAVARTH4, CMS SP_RA_OA.

items.label: Condition: Asthma
items.description: Whether the person has asthma (Asthma, SNOMED CT 195967001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ010, BRFSS ASTHMA3.

items.label: Condition: Cancer
items.description: Whether the person has cancer (Cancer, SNOMED CT 363346000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ220, BRFSS CHCOCNC1, CMS SP_CNCR.

items.label: Condition: Chronic Bronchitis
items.description: Whether the person has chronic bronchitis (Chronic Bronchitis, SNOMED CT 63480004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160K.

items.label: Condition: Congestive Heart Failure
items.description: Whether the person has congestive heart failure (Congestive Heart Failure, SNOMED CT 42343007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160B, CMS SP_CHF.

items.label: Condition: COPD
items.description: Whether the person has copd (COPD, SNOMED CT 13645005), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160O, BRFSS CHCCOPD3, CMS SP_COPD.

items.label: Condition: Coronary Heart Disease
items.description: Whether the person has coronary heart disease (Coronary Heart Disease, SNOMED CT 53741008), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160C, BRFSS CVDCRHD4, CMS SP_ISCHMCHT.

items.label: Condition: Depression
items.description: Whether the person has depression (Depression, SNOMED CT 35489007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS ADDEPEV3, CMS SP_DEPRESSN.

items.label: Condition: Diabetes
items.description: Whether the person has diabetes (Diabetes, SNOMED CT 73211009), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS DIABETE4, CMS SP_DIABETES.

items.label: Condition: Emphysema
items.description: Whether the person has emphysema (Emphysema, SNOMED CT 87433001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160G.

items.label: Condition: Heart Attack
items.description: Whether the person has heart attack (Heart Attack, SNOMED CT 22298006), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160E, BRFSS CVDINFR4.

items.label: Condition: High Blood Pressure
items.description: Whether the person has high blood pressure (High Blood Pressure, SNOMED CT 38341003), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS BPHIGH6.

items.label: Condition: High Cholesterol
items.description: Whether the person has high cholesterol (High Cholesterol, SNOMED CT 13644009), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS TOLDHI3.

items.label: Condition Indicator Basis
items.description: How a study established its chronic condition indicators: the person's report of what a health professional told them (NHANES, BRFSS) or the presence of qualifying diagnosis codes in claims (CMS). Stated once per record so the three studies compare on equal terms.

items.label: Condition: Kidney Disease
items.description: Whether the person has kidney disease (Kidney Disease, SNOMED CT 709044004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS CHCKDNY2, CMS SP_CHRNKIDN.

items.label: Condition: Liver Condition
items.description: Whether the person has liver condition (Liver Condition, SNOMED CT 235856003), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160L.

items.label: Condition: Osteoporosis
items.description: Whether the person has osteoporosis (Osteoporosis, SNOMED CT 64859006), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by CMS SP_OSTEOPRS.

items.label: Condition: Skin Cancer
items.description: Whether the person has skin cancer (Skin Cancer, SNOMED CT 372130007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS CHCSCNC1.

items.label: Condition: Stroke
items.description: Whether the person has stroke (Stroke, SNOMED CT 230690007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160F, BRFSS CVDSTRK3, CMS SP_STRKETIA.

items.label: Condition: Thyroid Problem
items.description: Whether the person has thyroid problem (Thyroid Problem, SNOMED CT 14304000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160M.

items.label: BRFSS Demographics
items.description: The respondent's demographics: the Default administrative gender and the BRFSS sex code, the NIH CDE age and the agency's imputed age, race/ethnicity as the NIH CDE and as BRFSS imputes it, education, marital status, employment and insurance as the NIH CDE and as BRFSS codes them, veteran status, pregnancy, children in the household and the agency's income range. Members: administrative-gender (Default); Sex of Respondent (SEXVAR); Age (NIH CDE); Imputed Age Value Collapsed Above 80 (_AGE80); Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification (NIH CDE); Imputed Race/Ethnicity Value (_IMPRACE); Current Educational Attainment (NIH CDE); Education Level (EDUCA); Marital Status (NIH CDE); Marital Status (MARITAL); Employment Status (NIH CDE); Employment Status (EMPLOY1); Category of Health Insurance (NIH CDE); Primary Source of Health Insurance (PRIMINSR); Veteran Status; Are you pregnant now? (NIH CDE); Pregnancy Status (PREGNANT); Number of Children in Household (CHILDREN); Income Level (INCOME3).

items.label: Education Level (EDUCA)
items.description: The highest grade or year of school completed (EDUCA). Kept beside the NIH CDE Current Educational Attainment it is mapped to.

enumerations: Never attended school or only kindergarten
College 1 year to 3 years (Some college or technical school)

items.label: Employment Status (EMPLOY1)
items.description: Employment status as BRFSS codes it (EMPLOY1). Kept beside the NIH CDE Employment Status it is mapped to.

enumerations: Out of work for 1 year or more
Out of work for less than 1 year

items.label: Imputed Race/Ethnicity Value (_IMPRACE)
items.description: Race and ethnicity as BRFSS imputes and codes it (_IMPRACE). Kept beside the NIH CDE Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification it is mapped to.

items.label: Income Level (INCOME3)
items.description: Annual household income from all sources in the agency's ranges (INCOME3). Not harmonized: the ranges do not nest with NHANES's or the NIH CDE's.

items.label: Marital Status (MARITAL)
items.description: Marital status as BRFSS codes it (MARITAL). Kept beside the NIH CDE Marital Status it is mapped to.

enumerations: A member of an unmarried couple

items.label: Pregnancy Status (PREGNANT)
items.description: Whether the respondent is pregnant (PREGNANT). Kept beside the NIH CDE pregnancy question it is mapped to.

items.label: Primary Source of Health Insurance (PRIMINSR)
items.description: The current primary source of health insurance coverage (PRIMINSR). Kept beside the NIH CDE Category of Health Insurance it is mapped to.

enumerations: A plan purchased through an employer or union
A private nongovernmental plan that you or another family member buys on your own

items.label: Sex of Respondent (SEXVAR)
items.description: The sex of the respondent as BRFSS codes it (SEXVAR). Kept beside the Default administrative gender it is mapped to.

items.label: Veteran Status
items.description: Whether the person has ever served on active duty in the United States Armed Forces (NHANES DMQMILIZ; BRFSS VETERAN3).

items.label: Are you pregnant now?
items.description: A textual description of the person's current pregnancy status. Also known as: Current Pregnancy Indicator. NIH CDE Repository, steward Project 5, tinyId LiUWCWluP, NIH endorsed. Corrected from the NIH CDE Repository record, whose LOINC answer codes are each one off (Yes was bound to LA26683-5 Not pregnant, No to LA4489-6 Unknown, Unknown to LA15173-0 Pregnant); the record's own NCI Thesaurus meanings (C49488 Yes, C49487 No, C17998 Unknown) agree with the codes used here.

items.label: Category of Health Insurance
items.description: A textual description of a person's insurance coverage for medical expenses. Question text: Category of Health Insurance? NIH CDE Repository, steward Project 5, tinyId cPiK4Amjn5, NIH endorsed.

items.label: Current Educational Attainment
items.description: A textual description of the grade or highest level of education attained by a human being. Question text: What is the highest grade or level of school you have completed or the highest degree you have received? NIH CDE Repository, steward Project 5, tinyId Co2d1RyYS3, NIH endorsed. Corrected from the NIH CDE Repository record, whose text carries the Windows-1252 apostrophe as the control character U+0092; it is the right single quotation mark (U+2019), as Windows-1252 defines byte 0x92.

enumerations: Bachelor’s Degree (Example: BA, AB, BS, BBA)
Master’s Degree (Example:  MA, MS, MEng, MEd, MBA)

items.label: Employment Status
items.description: The state of a person with regard to earning wages or salary. Question text: We would like to know about what you do: are you working now, looking for work, retired, keeping house, a student, or what? NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId RME88_Wg_hV, NIH endorsed.
items.value: Only temporarily laid off, or unpaid sick leave/parental leave/family leave/administrative leave

enumerations: Full-time working now or paid sick leave/parental leave/family leave/administrative leave
Part-time work or hourly less than full time
Only temporarily laid off, or unpaid sick leave/parental leave/family leave/administrative leave
Raising children full-time, full-time caregiver, or keeping house

items.label: Marital Status
items.description: A demographic parameter indicating a person's current conjugal status. Question text: What is your current marital status? NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId C6SezX_mKG, NIH endorsed.
items.value: Married or partnered, but not living together

enumerations: Living as married or living with a romantic partner
Married or partnered, but not living together
Single, never been married-not living with romantic partner

items.label: Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification
items.description: A textual description of a person's race. C17049 |The ethnicity of a person. C16564 | An individual's perspective or subjective interpretation of an event or information. C74528 Question text: Please select the racial/ethnic category or categories with which you most closely identify. Select all that apply. NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId LakF0YkywC, NIH endorsed.

enumerations: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

items.label: Administrative Gender
items.description: The gender a person is recorded as for administrative purposes. Not clinical or biological sex; see Sex (Recorded).

items.label: Imputed Age Value Collapsed Above 80 (_AGE80)
items.description: Imputed age in years, collapsed at 80 (_AGE80). The NIH CDE Age beside it carries the same value.

items.label: Number of Children in Household (CHILDREN)
items.description: The number of children less than 18 years of age in the household (CHILDREN).

items.label: Age
items.description: The number of years (if more than 24 months old) or months (if 24 months or younger) that the person has been alive. Question text: What is the person's age (in years if more than 24 months old or months if 24 months or younger)? NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId PDjBiGXjO, NIH endorsed.

items.label: BRFSS Disability
items.description: The six disability questions: hearing, vision, cognition, mobility, self-care and independent living. Members: Deaf or Serious Difficulty Hearing (DEAF); Blind or Serious Difficulty Seeing (BLIND); Serious Difficulty Concentrating, Remembering or Deciding (DECIDE); Serious Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs (DIFFWALK); Difficulty Dressing or Bathing (DIFFDRES); Difficulty Doing Errands Alone (DIFFALON).

items.label: Blind or Serious Difficulty Seeing (BLIND)
items.description: Blind or Serious Difficulty Seeing (BLIND), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: Deaf or Serious Difficulty Hearing (DEAF)
items.description: Deaf or Serious Difficulty Hearing (DEAF), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: Difficulty Doing Errands Alone (DIFFALON)
items.description: Difficulty Doing Errands Alone (DIFFALON), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: Difficulty Dressing or Bathing (DIFFDRES)
items.description: Difficulty Dressing or Bathing (DIFFDRES), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: Serious Difficulty Concentrating, Remembering or Deciding (DECIDE)
items.description: Serious Difficulty Concentrating, Remembering or Deciding (DECIDE), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: Serious Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs (DIFFWALK)
items.description: Serious Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs (DIFFWALK), the American Community Survey disability question as BRFSS asks it.

items.label: BRFSS Health Status and Access
items.description: General health as the shared component, the days physical and mental health were not good, time since the last checkup, and exercise in the past 30 days. Members: General Health Status; Days Physical Health Not Good, Past 30 (PHYSHLTH); Days Mental Health Not Good, Past 30 (MENTHLTH); Length of Time Since Last Routine Checkup (CHECKUP1); Exercise in Past 30 Days (EXERANY2).

items.label: Exercise in Past 30 Days (EXERANY2)
items.description: Whether the respondent took part in any physical activity or exercise in the past month other than their regular job (EXERANY2).

items.label: General Health Status
items.description: The person's rating of their general health (BRFSS GENHLTH; the NHANES HSQ question is the same scale when that file is carried).

items.label: Length of Time Since Last Routine Checkup (CHECKUP1)
items.description: How long since the respondent last visited a doctor for a routine checkup (CHECKUP1).

items.label: Days Mental Health Not Good, Past 30 (MENTHLTH)
items.description: The number of days in the past 30 the respondent's mental health was not good (MENTHLTH).

items.label: Days Physical Health Not Good, Past 30 (PHYSHLTH)
items.description: The number of days in the past 30 the respondent's physical health was not good (PHYSHLTH).

items.label: BRFSS Survey Design
items.description: The survey design fields a weighted estimate needs: the state, interview date, PSU, stratum and final weight. Members: State FIPS Code (_STATE); Interview Date (IDATE); Primary Sampling Unit (_PSU); Sample Design Stratification Variable (_STSTR); Final Weight: Land-line and Cell-phone Data (_LLCPWT).

items.label: Primary Sampling Unit (_PSU)
items.description: The primary sampling unit (_PSU), equal to the sequence number.

items.label: Sample Design Stratification Variable (_STSTR)
items.description: The sample design stratum (_STSTR).

items.label: State FIPS Code (_STATE)
items.description: The FIPS code of the state or territory of residence (_STATE).

items.label: Final Weight: Land-line and Cell-phone Data (_LLCPWT)
items.description: The final raked weight for the combined landline and cellphone sample (_LLCPWT).

items.label: Interview Date (IDATE)
items.description: The interview date (IDATE).

items.label: BRFSS Tobacco and Alcohol Use
items.description: Cigarette use: the two questions the shared smoking status derives from, the status, the agency's computed status, e-cigarette use; alcohol: days drinking, average drinks and binge occasions in the past 30 days. Members: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes (SMOKE100); Frequency of Days Now Smoking (SMOKDAY2); Smoking Status; Computed Smoking Status (_SMOKER3); Current E-cigarette Use (ECIGNOW2); Days in Past 30 Had Alcoholic Beverage (ALCDAY4); Average Alcoholic Drinks per Day in Past 30 (AVEDRNK3); Binge Drinking Occasions in Past 30 (DRNK3GE5).

items.label: Computed Smoking Status (_SMOKER3)
items.description: The agency's four-level computed smoking status (_SMOKER3). The shared Smoking Status beside it is derived from the same answers.

enumerations: Current smoker - now smokes every day
Current smoker - now smokes some days

items.label: Current E-cigarette Use (ECIGNOW2)
items.description: Whether the respondent now uses e-cigarettes every day, some days, or not at all, or never used them (ECIGNOW2).

enumerations: Never used e-cigarettes in your entire life

items.label: Frequency of Days Now Smoking (SMOKDAY2)
items.description: Whether the respondent now smokes cigarettes every day, some days or not at all (SMOKDAY2).

items.label: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes (SMOKE100)
items.description: Whether the respondent has smoked at least 100 cigarettes in their entire life (SMOKE100).

items.label: Smoking Status
items.description: Tobacco smoking status (LOINC 72166-2) as the survey establishes it: NHANES from SMQ020 and SMQ040, BRFSS from SMOKE100 and SMOKDAY2 (the agency's _SMOKER3 is kept beside it). The LOINC answer list LL2201-3.

items.label: Average Alcoholic Drinks per Day in Past 30 (AVEDRNK3)
items.description: The average number of drinks on the days the respondent drank (AVEDRNK3).

items.label: Binge Drinking Occasions in Past 30 (DRNK3GE5)
items.description: The number of occasions in the past 30 days the respondent had five (men) or four (women) or more drinks (DRNK3GE5).

items.label: Days in Past 30 Had Alcoholic Beverage (ALCDAY4)
items.description: The number of days in the past 30 the respondent had at least one alcoholic drink (ALCDAY4; the agency's per-week code is converted to days).

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.
